But the security proposal met with opposition from some GOP lawmakers who are questioning the timing of the request, the cost, and how the taxpayer dollars would be used. Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., acknowledged “ongoing vote issues” on Wednesday as leaders tried to measure Republican support and figure out what will be allowed in the bill under the chamber’s rules.
